perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.desc: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.desc: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.
